svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The router moved from host 2 to host 3. The provider still sends to host 2, whose public hook finds the prefix in moved_prefixes and tunnels the packet to host 3. Host 3 turns it into an unsolicited neighbor advertisement with the override flag, and the provider learns host 3 MAC.
